{{Quote|I'm unique. The galaxy hasn't seen a man like me since Nok Drayen wiped out half the Hutt Cartel in one night. My legend's just begun&mdash;how about being the first Jedi I ever kill?|Valon|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Valon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who joined the [[White Maw]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Valon launched raids against [[Rift Alliance]] coalition forces. After joining the [[White Maw]], Valon gathered many followers to serve by his side and take advantage on the Rift Alliance. Valon survived several attempts on his life, including the onslaughts from the Rift Alliance coalition forces and failed coups from overambitious [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

{{GameLS}}
In [[3642 BBY]], the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Galactic War|renewed conflict]], Valon was faced by the [[Barsen'thor]] who aided a Rift Alliance unit under the command of lieutenant [[Felix Iresso]]. After his first defeat by the [[Jedi Consular]], his body armor completely healed him and was willing to have his chance by defeating the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] once again. After the Consular managed to disable the armor, Valon was defeated, and attempted to make a deal with the Jedi to be given free rein to harass the Empire in exchange for his life. The Jedi Consular refused his offer and Valon was taken into [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] custody.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
If the [[Jedi Consular]] agrees to Captain Valon's deal he will serve the Rift Alliance, swearing his loyalty to the [[Jedi Consular]]. He can be sent to do the following:
*Support the Rift Alliance. Start shipping supplies to the Rift Alliance. Food, medicine, whatever they need.
*Gather more followers. For now, rally as many pirates as you can to our cause.
*Harass the Empire. Begin raiding Imperial shipping lanes and small vessels. Do plenty of damage.

Whatever the case, Captain Valon will later support the [[Jedi Consular]] taking out Empire ships for them along with other various service.
